data.name: Nandakishore
data.gender_notes: Nandakishore is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nandakishore is derived from Sanskrit roots, where Nanda means joy, bliss, or happiness. Kishore is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning 'Lord of all things'. This name signifies the joy one experiences in the presence of the divine Lord. The name Nandakishore carries the meaning “Joy (Nanda) and Lord Kishor (Kishore)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nandakishore usually hope their child will grow to embody joy (nanda) and lord kishor (kishore) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the joy and happiness one experiences in the presence of the divine.
data.etymology: Nandakishore belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy (Nanda) and Lord Kishor (Kishore).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nandakishore total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
